title: App-context page recipe
description: A page recipe: the composition for a page shape named by an app-context pattern. Authored at app-context/src/recipes/<slug>.json and derived per slug to app-context/dist/recipes/<slug>.json. A pattern says what a page shape is; a recipe says what it is made of. Recipes are derived from screenshots of the running product, not invented.

_meta.description: Stamped by the derive on the dist leaf only; absent from the authored source. Declared here because the root is additionalProperties:false, so without it no dist recipe validates against its own schema and the first validator wired into validate-schemas.yml would fail on every file.

examples.do_not_edit: Edit the app-context/src/ files; CI regenerates this file.

slug.description: Kebab-case identifier for the recipe; must equal the filename minus .json, and should match the app-context pattern it composes.

label.description: Human-readable display name of the page shape this recipe composes.

description.description: What the page shape is and what distinguishes it from adjacent shapes.
examples: Three pane faceted browse over a large item set: app sidebar, a fixed-width filter rail of collapsible facet groups, and a result list of composed cards.

when.description: Selection guidance, naming the shapes this one is most often confused with and why they do not fit. Read by whoever or whatever chooses a recipe.
examples: Use when the user narrows a large collection by several independent facets at once. Do not use table-list: a table cannot hold a filter rail or per-facet counts.

apps.description: App slugs where this page shape appears. Must resolve against app-context apps.

patterns.description: Slugs of the app-context patterns this recipe composes. The link back from a composition to the shape that names it.

tags.description: Free tags used to bias recipe selection against a pattern's own tags.

derivedFrom.description: Provenance of the composition. A recipe that has never been compared against the running product is a guess, so this field is required and records which screen it was taken from and when.

surface.description: The product surface the composition was taken from, as a person would navigate to it.

capturedOn.description: ISO date the product screen was captured. Ages the recipe honestly rather than implying it is current.

productVersion.description: Version or environment of the product screen captured, when known.

slots.description: Named regions of the page and what each holds, so a reader can see the shape without parsing the skeleton.

examples.rail: Filter rail: a range facet, a counted checkbox facet list

renderNotes.description: Renderer behaviours an author must know for this composition to draw correctly. Written so the next recipe does not rediscover them by looking at a broken page.
examples: Children of a VERTICAL frame must omit `sizing`: horizontal FILL emits flex:1, which in a column stretches them vertically.

skeleton.description: The composition itself: the node tree a consumer renders. Node-level shape is owned by the consuming renderer, so it is intentionally not constrained here beyond being an object.
